comments.body:
It's like for EPFL, you can't skip the first year.
It is designed to filter students by first giving them a chance with low admission requirements but heavy and difficult coursework to complete.

If it was possible to just go to an easier uni, take the first year, and then transfer to ETH, the school wouldn't have the prestige it has today.

Either you do the basisjahr, or you get excellent marks in your bsc and then apply for masters.
comments.author: Equivalent-Ad5185
